title: Practice 3: при, на поезде, в этом году

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Tom was injured in the fall.
exercises.why: «при» + prepositional. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom likes to ride freight trains.
exercises.why: «на» + prepositional for how you travel: на поезде, на машине. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I was in São Paulo in February.
exercises.why: «в» + prepositional. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Лев Толстой, «Анна Каренина»*
exercises.why: «на» + prepositional. From Лев Толстой, «Анна Каренина».

exercises.q: Всякое зло легко сокрушается при ___ (рождение).
exercises.prompt: Every evil is easily crushed at birth.
exercises.why: «при» + prepositional. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: На ___ (какой корабль) приплыл Том?
exercises.prompt: What ship did Tom arrive on?
exercises.why: «на» + prepositional for how you travel: на поезде, на машине. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Токийская фондовая биржа показала резкое оживление в ___ (конец) дня.
exercises.prompt: The Tokyo Stock Exchange rallied at the end of the day.
exercises.why: «в» + prepositional. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Пела и читала на ___ (литературное утро).
exercises.why: «на» + prepositional. From Иван Тургенев, «После смерти (Клара Милич)».

exercises.q: Tom's bumper was damaged in the accident.

exercises.q: How much would it cost to replace the head gasket on this car?

exercises.why: «на» + prepositional for how you travel: на поезде, на машине. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: How many operations has Dr. Jackson performed this month?

exercises.q: Красный и синий цвета при ___ (смешение) дают фиолетовый.
exercises.prompt: Red and blue paint mixed together give us purple.

exercises.q: Слива расцветает в ___ (март).
exercises.prompt: Plum blossoms come out in March.

exercises.q: На ___ (праздники) несколько раз собирались по поводу журнала.

exercises.q: Are you having any difficulty swallowing?
